(14th title) | premiers = | promoted = | relegated = | Dissolved = | continentalcup1 = | continentalcup1 qualifiers = | continentalcup2 = | continentalcup2 qualifiers = | matches = | total goals = | average goals = | league topscorer = | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | longest losses = | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2005–06 Argentine Primera División|2005–06]] | nextseason = [[2007–08 Argentine Primera División season|2007–08]] | extra information = }} The '''2006–07 Argentina Primera División''' was the 116th season of first division football in Argentina. [[Estudiantes de La Plata|Estudiantes (LP)]] won the Torneo Apertura and [[San Lorenzo de Almagro|San Lorenzo]] won the Torneo Clausura. [[Godoy Cruz Antonio Tomba|Godoy Cruz]], [[Club Atlético Nueva Chicago|Nueva Chicago]], and [[CA Belgrano|Belgrano]] were promoted from the [[2005–06 Primera B Nacional]]. At the end of the season, Belgrano and [[Quilmes Atlético Club|Quilmes]] were directly relegated to the [[Primera B Nacional]] and [[Club Atlético Huracán|Huracán]] and [[Club Atlético Tigre|Tigre]] promoted from Primera B Nacional after winning the relegation playoff against Godoy Cruz and Nueva Chicago respectively.
